Under ₹80,000 aim for a laptop with 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent 8-core processor; those matter far more than looks.

Memory: 16 GB is the floor for coding tools, browsers and Docker together. 32 GB is better if you find one in budget.
Processor: Ryzen 7 or Intel Core Ultra 5/7 class gives fast builds and good battery.
Screen and keyboard: a 14 to 15.6 inch matte full HD screen and a comfortable keyboard, since you'll stare at both all day.
Graphics card: skip it unless you train AI projects or game. It adds weight and cost.
